scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Give each item a clearly marked storage place.
families.actor_operation_target: Steward adds removable type labels and numbered shelf positions in existing cabinets.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Visible locations reduce cabinet search and make empty positions apparent during counting.
families.conditions: Retain every permanent asset number and keep materials and setup within the stated limits.
families.assumptions: Participants can recognize the labels and usually return items to assigned positions.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Use an anonymous borrowing and return tally.
families.actor_operation_target: Participants move an item-number card between available and borrowed columns when taking or returning equipment.
families.causal_path_or_observable: The tally exposes which items are in use and supports reconciliation with a physical count.
families.conditions: No name, account, phone, or contact information is collected.
families.assumptions: Participants reliably move the corresponding card; stationery fits the budget.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Establish one clearly marked return place in each room.
families.actor_operation_target: Participants put returned items in a designated cabinet section; the steward checks and reshelves them at session close.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Concentrating returns reduces scattered equipment and allows one orderly closing check.
families.conditions: Return sections fit existing cabinets and do not interrupt workshops.
families.assumptions: Stewards have enough closing time and participants follow the return routine.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Assign a usual stock of each equipment type to each room.
families.actor_operation_target: Steward divides existing stock between rooms and records temporary transfers on a shared sheet.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Local availability reduces cross-room searches while transfer records explain count differences.
families.conditions: All items retain asset numbers and remain available to either workshop when needed.
families.assumptions: Room demand can be served by a reasonable initial split and occasional transfers.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Where is request time actually spent?
families.actor_operation_target: Steward times searches at cabinets, occupied tables, and the other room during ordinary requests.
families.causal_path_or_observable: A stage breakdown distinguishes locating stored equipment from finding equipment already in use.
families.conditions: Observation must not impede the workshop.
families.assumptions: The sampled requests represent ordinary demand.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: When and under which session conditions do count discrepancies arise?
families.actor_operation_target: Steward compares closing and later physical counts by item, transfer history, session size, and volunteer experience.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Item-level reconciliation may reveal returns, transfers, or recording errors behind discrepancies.
families.conditions: Use existing asset numbers and minimal additional paperwork.
families.assumptions: Counts can be compared at defined times without intervening unrecorded movements.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
